description: Defines the ResourceObject class which represents a JSON:API resource object in Drupal, wrapping Drupal entities and managing their serialization, links, and fields.

classes.name: ResourceObject
classes.description: Represents a JSON:API resource object, wrapping Drupal entities and managing serialization, links, and fields.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Creates a ResourceObject instance from a Drupal entity, extracting fields and building links.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if the resource object has a specific public field.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field by its public name.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns all fields of the resource object.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language of the resource object.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Returns the links associated with the resource object.

methods.name: getVersionIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the version identifier if the resource type is versionable.

methods.name: toUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the resource object based on its 'self' link.

methods.name: extractFieldsFromEntity
methods.description: Extracts fields from an entity, content or config.

methods.name: buildLinksFromEntity
methods.description: Builds links for an entity, including version and self links if applicable.

methods.name: extractContentEntityFields
methods.description: Extracts fields from a content entity, with special handling for user display names.

methods.name: getLabelFieldName
methods.description: Determines the label field name for an entity, with special handling for users.

methods.name: extractConfigEntityFields
methods.description: Extracts fields from a config entity, filtering based on resource type.
